Name: Fish Trap and Garbage Net
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Want a new way to automate fishing? Only use crab pots for the trash they give you? Well this mod is for you!

Introducing the fish trap and the garbage net!

Fish Trap: When loaded with bait, it will catch a random fish from the location it is placed in overnight. Note: doesn't work in bodies of water with no chance of catching fish. 
﻿Different bait will give different outputs:
﻿ ﻿Regular bait: Acts like normal
﻿ ﻿Wild bait: Chance of double fish
﻿ ﻿Deluxe bait: Gives gold star fish
﻿ ﻿Challenge bait: Gives between 1-3 fish
﻿ ﻿Magic bait: Works like magic bait
﻿ ﻿*Targeted bait doesn't work
﻿Grants a small amount of fishing experience when harvested.
﻿At level 6 farming, the fish trap recipe is unlocked and Willy will sell it.
﻿Legendary fish will not be caught in the fish trap.
﻿*﻿Fish caught in the fish trap don't count towards perfection.
﻿*Doesn't work in mines or in the Caldera.

Garbage Net: When placed in water overnight it will collect a random piece of trash. Grants a very small amount of fishing experience when harvested. Recipe and Willy's shop unlocked at level 4 fishing.
